child_list.content: Adding feet to a snake
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: Long ago, there was a king, and he liked to have parties. At one of those parties, the king asked the people to draw a snake. He said, “Whoever finishes first will get a special prize.” Everyone was excited and started to draw. Soon one man finished his drawing. “I’ve finished first,” he said. Then seeing others still drawing, he said, “Oh, I can add feet to the snake.” While the man was drawing the feet, another person had finished. And that person got the prize!

child_list.content: 画蛇添足
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
很久以前，有一位国王，他喜欢举行宴会。在一次宴会上，国王让人们画一条蛇。他说：“谁先完成，谁就会得到特

别的奖。”每个人都很兴奋，开始画画。

很快，一个人画完了他的画。“我第一个

完成了，”他说。然后看到别人还在画，

他说：“哦，我还可以给蛇加上脚呢。”当这个人还在画脚的时候，另一个人已经画好了。那个人得了奖！

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
